    Class HandlerManager

    Registry of named interaction handlers owned by Emap. Owns the single-DOM-listener pointer arbitration layer: installs one set of pointer listeners, normalizes events, and dispatches to enabled handlers in fixed priority order with an exclusive-gesture lock.

    Example

    Runnable example association: geoparquet-viewer.
